Step.name: # (comment)
Step.Text: PURPOSE: Build the print payload for a Nivelacija and hand it to the document service for rendering. Read-only against FileMaker — it changes nothing, so it is safe to run against a posted document as many times as you like.

Step.name: Insert Text
Step.Text:
PARAMS (JSON): nivelacijaId required. operation "payload" build and return the payload, make no HTTP call. Default. "generate-pdf" build it, POST it, return the service response. endpoint optional override. Default "/api/nivelacija-pdf".
RETURNS data: payload the full envelope (always) apiResponse the service's raw JSON (generate-pdf only)
WHY "payload" IS THE DEFAULT: The document service does not have this endpoint yet. Running with the default gives you the exact JSON it will receive, to hand to whoever builds it, without needing the service to exist. Switch to generate-pdf once the endpoint answers.
THE PRINTED COLUMNS ARE NET, AND THAT IS THE POINT: staraCijena / novaCijena / ranijaVrijednost / novaVrijednost / efekat are all VAT-EXCLUSIVE, because that is what shows the real movement. Under a hold-the-price nivelacija the gross figures are identical on both sides and every efekat would print as zero; net, the same document shows the whole VAT being absorbed out of the margin.
Because a nivelacija never touches cost, the net value difference IS the razlika-u-cijeni movement — efekat and razlikaRUC are the same number, and both are in the payload under both names so the template can use whichever reads better.
The gross figures ride along under the *Bruto suffix. The trgovacka knjiga takes efekatBruto, never efekat. They are different numbers with different consumers; never derive one from the other at render time.
NUMBERS ARE RAW: every amount is a JSON number, unformatted and unrounded beyond what was stored. Locale formatting — comma decimal separator, dot thousands, three decimals on prices — belongs to the template, not here.
STORING THE PDF: this script does not write Nivelacija::PDFFile. Set Field on a container needs record context and no layout exists for this table yet. Once one does, storing is one step on the returned pdfBase64 — see KMP__Print (819) for the shape.

Step.name: # (comment)
Step.Text: ── Header. The seven stored totals are read as written at posting time and never recomputed here — a filed document must print the same numbers every time it is printed. ──

Value.Calculation: epSQLExecute ( "SELECT Nivelacija.BrojNivelacije, Nivelacija.DatumNivelacije, Nivelacija.Status," & " Nivelacija.DatumKnjizenja, Nivelacija.NacinIzmjene, Nivelacija.Napomena," & " Nivelacija.ForeignKeyCompanyID," & " Nivelacija.UkupnoStaraVrijednost, Nivelacija.UkupnoNovaVrijednost, Nivelacija.UkupnoRazlika," & " Nivelacija.UkupnoStaraVrijednostBezPDV, Nivelacija.UkupnoNovaVrijednostBezPDV," & " Nivelacija.UkupnoRazlikaRUC, Nivelacija.UkupnoRazlikaPDV" & " FROM Nivelacija WHERE Nivelacija.PrimaryKey = ?" ; "useSQLResult=rs_hdr" ; $nivelacijaId )

Step.name: # (comment)
Step.Text: ── Lines, in document order. Both quantity columns on the specimen form are the same number here: this system prices per batch, so a line has one old price and one new price and never needs the split-row padding the specimen uses. ──

Value.Calculation: epSQLExecute ( "SELECT StavkeNivelacije.RedniBroj, StavkeNivelacije.Sifra, StavkeNivelacije.Naziv," & " StavkeNivelacije.JM, StavkeNivelacije.KolicinaNaStanju," & " StavkeNivelacije.StaraMPCijenaBezPDV, StavkeNivelacije.StaraVrijednostBezPDV," & " StavkeNivelacije.NovaMPCijenaBezPDV, StavkeNivelacije.NovaVrijednostBezPDV," & " StavkeNivelacije.RazlikaRUC," & " StavkeNivelacije.StaraMPCijena, StavkeNivelacije.StaraVrijednost," & " StavkeNivelacije.NovaMPCijena, StavkeNivelacije.NovaVrijednost," & " StavkeNivelacije.RazlikaVrijednost, StavkeNivelacije.RazlikaPDV," & " StavkeNivelacije.StariPDVPostotak, StavkeNivelacije.NoviPDVPostotak," & " StavkeNivelacije.NabavnaCijenaEfektivna, StavkeNivelacije.StariRUCIznos," & " StavkeNivelacije.NoviRUCIznos, StavkeNivelacije.ForeignKeyStavkaPrimkeID," & " StavkeNivelacije.NacinIzmjene" & " FROM StavkeNivelacije" & " WHERE StavkeNivelacije.ForeignKeyNivelacijaID = ?" & " ORDER BY StavkeNivelacije.RedniBroj" ; "useSQLResult=rs_lines" ; $nivelacijaId )

Step.name: # (comment)
Step.Text: ── POST to the document service. Same host, key derivation and cURL shape as INV__CallFiscalAPI (880) — one service, one auth scheme. The key is SHA256 of the shared secret and this machine's PersistentID, so under PSoS it is the SERVER's id; confirm the service accepts it before relying on a headless path. ──

Value.Calculation: Response_AddError ( "CONNECTION_ERROR" ; "Ne mogu se povezati na servis za dokumente (FM greška " & $fmErr & ")." ; "url" ; JSONSetElement ( "{}" ; "url" ; $url ; JSONString ) ; "" )
Response_AddError ( "INVALID_RESPONSE" ; "Neispravan odgovor servisa za dokumente." ; "" ; JSONSetElement ( "{}" ; "raw" ; Left ( $apiResponse ; 2000 ) ; JSONString ) ; "" )
